publish_failure_root_cause_investigation.question: Why did Printify stop the TikTok publish as an error?
publish_failure_root_cause_investigation.headline_finding: It did NOT stop it as an error. Printify never emits a failure. It accepts the request, fires product:publish:started, then silently abandons the job - no success, no failure, no listing.

probes.conclusion: No prior event capture existed on this shop.
Printify DOES validate topics, so acceptance of product:publish:failed proves that event genuinely exists in Printify's model.

probes.probe: Registered product:publish:failed -> Make hook, then published
probes.result: No delivery. hooks_ping showed learning:true, dataStructure:null, queueCount 0.

probes.probe: Registered product:publish:started -> same Make hook, then published
probes.result: DELIVERED. hooks_ping flipped to learning:false with a captured dataStructure.
probes.conclusion: POSITIVE CONTROL. The Make hook does receive Printify webhooks, which converts the failed-topic silence from an untested negative into a VERIFIED negative.
Job ran and ended with no listing.

verified_sequence: 3. is_locked briefly true, then false within ~5 seconds
6. Native Printify UI produces the same generic failure
what_this_rules_out: TikTok product-category or brand/IP rejection - a rejection returns a reason and would fire product:publish:failed. Nothing fired.
sales_channel_properties - separately falsified; writable, populated, publish still failed.
Malformed product data - Printify validates on its own side and would report it as a failure event.
Transport or polling error on our side - the started event proves the webhook path works end to end.
publish_failure_root_cause_investigation.leading_conclusion: This is a Printify-side integration fault on the TikTok channel, not a validation rejection of this product. The publish job is dispatched and then dies without reporting. Because it fails silently on BOTH the API and the native UI, it is not something our execution path can fix.

If a control republishes cleanly, the fault is specific to blueprint 1522 / provider 23. NOT RUN - it pushes an update to a live listing and needs D'Andre's authorisation.

artifacts_left_in_place.note: Deliberately left active so the next publish attempt captures any failure reason automatically. Remove when the batch closes.

knowledge_for_operating_file: Printify validates webhook topics: an invalid topic returns [400] Webhook validation failed. That makes webhook registration a reliable way to test which events exist.
product:publish:started and product:publish:failed are both real Printify topics.
A TikTok publish that returns HTTP 200 and fires publish:started but never publish:failed is a silent Printify-side abandonment, not a product rejection.
There is no publishing_status endpoint - it 404s.

round_2.headline: Found the mechanism. The Printify TikTok publish worker actively CLEARS the product's TikTok fulfilment config (delivery_service_id / warehouse_id) and aborts, without emitting any failure event.

discovery_duplicate_product.title: Copy of Chrome Orchard AirPods Max Case, Burgundy Cobalt Art Headphone Cover, Matte Hard Shell
discovery_duplicate_product.origin: Created by the native Printify UI publish attempt - the UI duplicated the product rather than publishing the original.
discovery_duplicate_product.significance: It carries REAL TikTok values that no other product had: delivery_service_id 7129736060325594926, warehouse_id 7682935300981671693. So the UI does know this shop's TikTok warehouse and delivery service.
discovery_duplicate_product.outcome: It ALSO failed - external.id is empty. A product configured by Printify's own UI, with valid TikTok fulfilment IDs, still did not publish.
discovery_duplicate_product.action_required: CLEANUP - this is an unwanted duplicate in the TikTok shop. Not deleted; deletion is D'Andre's call.

controlled_experiment.step_1: PUT sales_channel_properties = {delivery_service_id 7129736060325594926, warehouse_id 7682935300981671693, free_shipping false} at 15:21:44 - accepted, values confirmed in the response.
controlled_experiment.step_3: Product updated_at moved to 15:21:57, so the publish worker did touch the product.
controlled_experiment.step_4: Fresh GET at 15:23:13 - sales_channel_properties back to {null, null, false}.
controlled_experiment.result: REPRODUCIBLE. The publish attempt resets the TikTok fulfilment config to null. Observed twice.
controlled_experiment.conclusion: Printify is not ignoring the publish. It runs, evaluates the product against TikTok fulfilment, rejects the warehouse/delivery binding, wipes it, and stops - silently.

failure_event_recheck.method: Re-armed hook learning mode (the detector proven to work when it caught product:publish:started), re-pointed product:publish:started away so only product:publish:failed could deliver.
failure_event_recheck.result: learning stayed true, dataStructure null - no failure event fired even WITH real fulfilment IDs.
failure_event_recheck.note: queueCount is NOT a reliable detector here - with no scenario attached Make appears to discard rather than queue. Learning mode is the reliable signal.

round_2.revised_conclusion: The fault is in the Printify->TikTok fulfilment binding for this product, not in our data, not in the artwork, and not in a missing field. Evidence: (a) Printify's own UI built a copy with valid TikTok warehouse/delivery IDs and that copy failed too; (b) supplying those same valid IDs by API gets them wiped by the publish worker; (c) no failure event is ever emitted. The most consistent explanation is that blueprint 1522 / print provider 23 (WOYC) cannot be bound to this TikTok shop's fulfilment - both known-good published products use print_provider_id 92.
recommended_next_steps: Ask Printify support directly, quoting product 6aa223d66c320fa5a00b1bb6, shop 28861434, blueprint 1522, provider 23, and the reproducible symptom that publish nulls sales_channel_properties without emitting product:publish:failed. This is a supplier-side answer, not one obtainable from our surface.
Or re-source this product on a TikTok-proven provider. Provider 92 is the only one with demonstrated TikTok publishes in this shop.
Or route to Etsy, where this pipeline is fully automated and proven.
Delete the duplicate 'Copy of' product 6aa2b485eb6241a761040522 either way.
